label: Output
description: Terminal node that delivers workflow results. Can display on-screen, save to a database table, expose a shortcode/HTML, POST to a webhook, or write to Google Sheets / Google Drive.

config.name: outputType
config.description: Where the result is delivered. display/webhook run in Cloud; save/database/shortcode/post are rewritten to a wpAction; googleSheets/googleDrive run Locally only.

config.name: selectedTable
config.description: Target table name when outputType is save.

config.name: columns
config.description: Column definitions for the save table.

config.name: fieldMappings
config.description: Maps table fields to node inputs.

config.name: webhookUrl
config.description: Target URL when outputType is webhook.

config.name: webhookKeys
config.description: Key mapping objects for the webhook payload.

config.name: columnMappings
config.description: Maps sheet columns to node inputs.

produces.note: Workflow endpoint. `display` just shows [Input from upstream].

consumes.note: For outputType `save` (fieldMappings) or `googleSheets` (columnMappings), each column maps to its OWN upstream field: same shape rules as the Post node. For `display`/`webhook` a single [Input from upstream] blob is fine.
